text:
Type: swing-arm floor lamp with drum shade
Use: reading light that reaches over a sofa or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: white fabric drum shade, nickel-plated steel pole and arm, round metal base
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: cylindrical shade at the end of a long horizontal arm that swings out from a slim pole, round flat base, tall and angular, light visual weight
Feel: calm, practical, elegant, soft
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, light wood, white walls, silver accents; contemporary or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: SAMTID
product.description: Gives both directed and diffused light.
